additionalDescription: Documentation is often an afterthought, but it is the first thing developers see when evaluating an API. Scalar was built on the belief that great documentation should be effortless to create and a pleasure to read. Every design decision was made with both the documentation author and the API consumer in mind.
highlights: Built an OpenAPI 3.1 parser with comprehensive spec validation
Created an interactive API playground for testing endpoints
Implemented automatic code generation in 10+ programming languages
Designed a theming system matching any brand identity
